technical_quality: Adequate PA erect film (gastric bubble present). No significant rotation (medial clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes); penetration acceptable with thoracic vertebrae faintly visible through the cardiac shadow. Inspiration adequate but slightly shallow (about 8-9 posterior ribs, hemidiaphragms mildly elevated), which may marginally exaggerate cardiac size. Breast shadows overlie both lower zones. A black rectangular bar along the left image edge is a collimation/processing artifact and does not affect interpretation.

laterality_sources.bbox: patient-left, middle zone (radiologist box 554x387 px centred over the cardiac silhouette; cardiomegaly has no side)
laterality_sources.reader_b: bilateral / lower (blind; independently reported mild cardiomegaly, CTR ~0.55-0.57)
laterality_sources.adjudicator: none / lower (midline cardiac silhouette; measured cardiac transverse diameter ~480 px vs inner thoracic width ~845 px, CTR ~0.57)

devices.type: External film marker: 'L' side marker with technologist initials plus round radiopaque lead disc (outside the patient)
devices.location: Upper right corner of the image, lateral to the patient's left shoulder soft tissue, outside the thorax

devices.type: Image artifact: black rectangular collimation/processing bar (not a medical device)
devices.location: Extreme left edge of the image (patient's right), upper third, outside the patient

other_findings: 雙側橫膈略高，吸氣深度略不足(約8–9根後肋)，屬技術因素，非真正病變
兩側下肺野有乳房軟組織陰影重疊(正常女性表現)
左上腹可見胃泡及腸氣(正常)
雙側肺野清晰，無實質浸潤、結節、間質性水腫或肋膜積液，雙側肋膈角銳利
縱膈與氣管居中，主動脈弓小(年輕病人)，肺門血管無明顯充血
suitability_reason: 標的病灶(輕度心臟擴大，心胸比約0.55–0.57)清楚可見；片上無任何導管、引流管、心律調節器或其他治療裝置，亦無術後變化。肺野清晰、無肺水腫或肋膜積液，適合作為初次就診之影像(例如心肌病變、瓣膜性心臟病或高血壓性心臟病的早期表現)，但不適合用於急性失代償性心衰竭合併肺水腫的情境。
description_zh: 胸部正面(PA)立位攝影，吸氣深度尚可但略顯不足(約8–9根後肋)，無明顯旋轉，穿透度適中。心影輕度擴大，心胸比約0.55–0.57(心臟橫徑估計約16–17公分)，左心緣圓鈍並向左外側突出，右心緣亦稍為凸出，心影位於中下縱膈、無側別之分；縱膈與氣管居中，主動脈弓小(年輕病人)，肺門血管無明顯充血。雙側肺野清晰，未見實質浸潤、結節、間質性水腫或肋膜積液，雙側肋膈角銳利，雙側橫膈略高，兩側下肺野可見乳房軟組織陰影重疊，左上腹可見胃泡及腸氣。骨骼結構無明顯異常。影像右上角(病人左肩外側)可見「L」側別標記(含技術員縮寫)及圓形鉛標記，影像左緣有一黑色長條狀準直/處理偽影，均為體外物件；未見任何導管、引流管、心律調節器或其他治療裝置。
